gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Flat and stencil-cut, Coming Soon looks scribbled by hand yet holds its lines steady. Noto Sans Osmanya sits next to it with wide, easy s turns and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-h: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong reads as a contemporary sans with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap open like a cracked bangle. Coming Soon's casual hand makes it feel personal.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-palmyren: Smooth, tube-like lines give Coming Soon a casual, pen-and-paper feel with lowercase that climbs close to its capitals. But Noto Sans Palmyrene has compressed ascenders and curves that stop short, so give it a little extra size.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-: Casual and personal, Coming Soon scrawls its letters with no thick or thin to them. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau follows in a plain sans, its open-ended curves giving paragraphs room to breathe, with capitals only a short step above the lowercase.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Approachable is the word for Noto Sans PhagsPa, a sans-serif whose c openings you can see through and whose capitals rise in a gentle bump above the small letters. Coming Soon adds a steady, technical-pen hand.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-phoenici: Coming Soon's stroke ends are as wide as the middle of each line, a casual handwritten look with lowercase rising close to its capitals. Noto Sans Phoenician brings generous lowercase height and wide-open s curves, a modern plain sans partner.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-psalter-: Flat, contrast-free handwriting like a quick note to a friend. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi takes over below as a plain sans with gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals, approachable and workmanlike.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang is a professional sans-serif with lowercase counters like wide glass portholes and distinct open gaps in c, e, s, and a. Coming Soon does casual, constant-width handwriting best; this one does clarity.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-runic: Coming Soon writes in a calm, unvarying weight, casual and personal. It does handwriting charm best, while Noto Sans Runic handles the work of a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-samarita: Noto Sans Samaritan has a hefty lowercase body and curves with plenty of daylight inside, a plain sans that feels approachable. But Coming Soon, with strokes as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner, adds a casual hand-lettered note above it.
